notes.title: Version 1.06 patch notes (4/19/17)
notes.content:
Hey all,

In this patch we fixed up various rare crashes to try and stabilize the game on weaker PCs. Let us know if these fixes cause any issues!

Aside from anything game-breaking, this will be the last patch for a while as the devs move on to other projects. Feel free to keep suggesting features and reporting bugs on the discussion thread. We'll definitely keep them in mind for any future releases ;D

Love,
XSEED Games

notes.title: Version 1.05 patch notes (4/10/17)
notes.content:
Mostly mouse control tweaks which I think we're finally comfortable with...

- Upped the speed of the camera when it is controlled by the mouse
- Locked the mouse to the game window
- The mouse cursor now hides during battle
- Added a Mouse Camera Controls [Enabled/Disabled] toggle in Settings (This also affects Dressing Room camera functionality)
- Sun Ce's idle animation has been fixed (for realsies this time)
- Minor Chinese text updates
- Frantic Mode can now be activated with the mouse

notes.title: Version 1.04 patch notes (3/31/17)
notes.content:
-The camera will now follow the mouse without needing to hold down any key. I'd revisit keybindings to make sure everything's set correctly for that (right click, left click, and mouse wheel click are ideal for attacks and dashing). We're still planning on tweaking this a bit more.
-Bots will no longer fill a multiplayer lobby when "None" is selected for a character slot.
-The Tech List key binding was causing issues, so we've reverted it to the PS4 state (in which it did not exist)

notes.title: Version 1.03 patch notes (3/28/17)
notes.content:
Hope you enjoyed that single day on patch 1.02! Our devs are beastly.

- Murakumo (No Mask) is now displayed properly in multiplayer
- A lone character can now be changed to a different character in the Dressing Room without crashing
- The leaderboards now display usernames of players rank 32 and below
- Title screen voice is now randomized
- Multiplayer now displays characters' names in Japanese (Japanese only)
- R3 button is now properly displayed on the tips message (Korean only)

We're still looking into improving mouse-look controls ːsteamhappyː

Be sure to check out the pinned bug and features thread for live updates on what we're working on:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/502800/discussions/0/133259956025055943/

notes.title: Version 1.02 patch notes (3/27/17)
notes.content:
-Crash fixes from 1.01 are back in this version
-L3 and R3 buttons are now assigned to X and B keys. 
LStick = WASD
RStick = TGFH
DPad = Arrow Keys
X Button = I
Y Button = O
A Button = K
B Button = L
L3 = X
R3 = B
LBumper = Q
RBumper = R
LTrigger = 1
RTrigger = 4
START Button = Tab
BACK Button = Esc

-Lu Bu's hair will no longer mysteriously disappear in multiplayer
-[strike]Sun Ce will no longer flip upside-down during her idle animation in multiplayer[/strike] Just kidding, she really likes being upside-down. We're working on this!
-Fixed a bug where CPU difficulty could not be changed after starting a new lobby in multiplayer
-Mouse can now be used to control the camera by holding down the left mouse button
-Key bindings now save after quitting the game
-All players in Shinobi Survival mode now continue with the same waves

notes.title: Version 1.01 patch notes (3/23/17)
notes.content:
We're temporarily reverting to Version 1.00 while we iron out some issues with this patch. Sorry for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience!

-Fixed crashes related to XAudio2_7.dll
-Fixed crashes caused by tablet and touch screen devices running TabTip.exe
-Game will no longer launch if there are corrupted files in the main installation folder

Be especially mindful of the last point, and let us know if any new issues crop up!

We're working on other fixes, but we wanted to get these out as soon as possible.
